subject: physics

hotspots.label: Battery Bank
hotspots.description: The stack of 1.5 V cells whose push the voltmeter reads.
hotspots.colorHint: Warm cell tower in a holder.
hotspots.function: Stores and delivers the voltage push.

hotspots.label: Add Cell
hotspots.description: Tap to add another 1.5 V cell to the stack; volts and bulb brightness climb.
hotspots.colorHint: A small upward arrow chip above the bank.
hotspots.function: Raises the battery bank's total voltage.

hotspots.label: Remove Cell
hotspots.description: Tap to take the last cell out; the voltmeter and bulb drop together.
hotspots.colorHint: A small downward arrow chip below the bank.
hotspots.function: Lowers the battery bank's total voltage.

hotspots.label: Voltmeter
hotspots.description: The instrument straddling the bank's two ends, reading volts.
hotspots.colorHint: Round pale-green gauge with two probes.
hotspots.function: Reads the potential difference in volts.

hotspots.label: Wire Loop
hotspots.description: The wire path the push drives current around.
hotspots.colorHint: Cool clear-grey loop from bank to bulb and back.
hotspots.function: Carries the current the voltage pushes.

hotspots.label: Bulb
hotspots.description: Glows brighter with every added volt — the visible effect of the push.
hotspots.colorHint: Small clear bulb whose warm glow grows.
hotspots.function: Shows the current's response to voltage.

visualStyleNotes: Warm off-white paper ground, soft vignette. A small battery bank tower, a cool wire loop, a round voltmeter, and a bulb whose glow scales with added cells.
materialNotes: Metallic=0, roughness ~0.5. Cells warm red/ochre; voltmeter face pale green; bulb glass clear with warm emissive-only-in-glow kept dim.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: voltage as the push driving a bulb on a simple loop.

GEOMETRY: a holder for up to six 1.5 V cells; a wire loop to a bulb; a voltmeter across the bank; add/remove chips.

INTERACTION: add/remove chips slide cells; voltmeter = cells × 1.5 V; bulb glow and simulated ammeter rise with volts.

NAMED NODES: BankHolder, CellStack, AddChip, RemoveChip, Voltmeter, LoopWire, BulbGlow. 7-10k tris.
